title: Hell is Us
summary: Hell is Us is Nacon's third-person action-adventure, with a Switch 2 release date of October 8, 2026 and a price of $59.99. The 23.9 GB size comes from the pre-release eShop listing and may change once the launch patch is out. The physical edition is a Game-Key Card, which means the cartridge does not contain the game data; plan to download the full game after inserting it, and keep that space free. Nacon has not published resolution or frame rate figures for the Switch 2 version yet, so this page will be updated once independent tests are available. The eShop lists 11 languages, including Spanish.
